launch_evidence.quote: We continued to expand our leadership in CF and build global momentum for CASGEVY, and we launched JOURNAVX in moderate-to-severe acute pain,” said Reshma Kewalramani, M.D., Chief Executive Officer and President of Vertex. (Vertex Q1 2025 release, Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 filed 2025-05-05)

series_start_reason: JOURNAVX was approved 2025-01-30 and launched in Q1 2025; the series starts at the launch quarter.
search_log: Listed every Vertex (CIK 875320) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions; scanned every 8-K with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K filed 2024-10-01 to 2026-11-04 for 'ALYFTREK|JOURNAVX' in table rows and text (bin/scan.py).

During 2025 Vertex reported JOURNAVX inside 'Other product revenues' and gave its amount only in sentences: Q1 2025 10-Q 'an insignificant amount from JOURNAVX' (no figure); Q2 and Q3 2025 10-Q MD&A sentences (three-month and year-to-date figures); Q4 2025 release footnote (three and twelve months). The 2025 releases for Q1-Q3 print no JOURNAVX figure. From Q1 2026 the releases print a JOURNAVX table row with the prior-year column.
2025Q1 is therefore the Q1 2026 release's prior-year column (1.3); 2025Q2-Q4 are the current-period sentences; 2026Q1-Q2 the table rows.

Checks: year-to-date sentences agree with the quarters (1.3 + 12.0 = 13.3; 13.3 + 19.6 = 32.9; 32.9 + 26.7 = 59.6, the twelve-month figure; FY2025 10-K also states $59.6 million from JOURNAVX). Prior-year columns of the Q2 2026 release (12.0; six months 13.3) match.
